title: Curation patch entry
description: One line of names/work/curate-patch.jsonl: a decision the curation view (web `?curate`) made about one row of names/places.csv, which `names/curate.py apply` writes back. The browser appends through the Vite dev server (web/vite-plugins/curate.ts), which keeps only these properties and sets `at`. The rules that need the name list (is the row the matcher's, is the slug free) are apply's.

id.description: The places.csv row's `id` -- what apply finds the row by.

line.description: The row's line in places.csv when the worklist was exported; for messages only.

kind.description: The row's kind; for messages only.

name.description: The row's Frisian name; for messages only.

de.description: The row's German name; for messages only.

action.description: osm: the row is these OSM objects; local: a place OSM does not have, at lat/lon; skip: never on the map; clear: withdraw the row's earlier decision.

wikidata.description: action=osm: the object's Wikidata id, if it has one.

slug.description: action=local: the slug of the local reference `local/<slug>`.

polygon_km2.description: action=local: label the place with a square of this area instead of a node.

note.description: Free text for the curation row.

at.description: When the dev server stored the entry (ISO 8601).

slug.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens -- the shape of a row id and a local reference.
